_how_to: Maintained by Andrew via Muse, in the PermitPicker chat: 'sent lead <id> to <contractor>' adds a dispatch (Muse sets homeowner check due +2d, contractor check due +7d); 'freebie sent to <contractor>' logs the one free lead; '<contractor> subscribed' adds an all-access subscriber (category = trades preference only, never a gate; priority_next: true = dead-lead credit, jumps the queue); outcome reports ('<contractor> won lead <id>' / 'dead lead') close the checks. The hourly lead-alerts job reads this file — subscribers float to the top of shortlists badged, and due follow-ups ride the alert emails plus a once-daily reminder.
